bio.text: Tom Delnicki represents Connecticut's 14th House District, South Windsor, and was first elected in November 2016.
He has served on the South Windsor Town Council from 1995 to 2007 and from 2009 to the present, including two terms as mayor.

A lifelong South Windsor resident, he graduated from South Windsor High School in 1974, attended the University of Connecticut, and retired from the Metropolitan District as a Facilities/Maintenance Supervisor.
